note: Task chain for the QUESTS screen. Objective kinds: extract (come back alive from a map), loot (bring back N of an item or category), deliver (hand N over from the stash). Rewards are roubles, trader standing, and items. requires lists quest ids that must be claimed first, so the chain is a graph, not a list.

quests.title: First Blood
quests.text: You want work? Good. Go to Customs, walk out alive, and I will know you are not a liability.

quests.title: Field Kit
quests.text: My boys are bleeding faster than I can resupply them. Bring me bandages - the cheap ones will do.

quests.title: Under the Factory
quests.text: The Factory is small, dark and full of people who want your rifle. Come out of it once and I will believe you.

quests.title: Bring Back the Good Stuff
quests.text: BT goes for a fortune and I am not paying it. Two boxes, brought back in one piece.

quests.title: Something for the Wounded
quests.text: A Salewa kit, brought back from a raid, not bought from me. I want to know it can be done.

quests.title: Full Shelves
quests.text: Food is the quiet part of survival. Four rations, and I will remember your name.
